description: Textured 3D model (GLB) from an image or a text prompt. texel-3d-pro = state of the art, highest quality, HD texture with PBR maps (base color, metal/roughness, normal); texel-3d-alt = another excellent option, PBR maps; texel-3d-express = fast, decent quality (~20K triangles, PBR); texel-3d-draft = very fast drafts and distant props, color texture only, not for final quality. Without image_url, a reference image is generated from the prompt first. Asynchronous: returns a generation id; poll get_generation. Spends credits (refunded automatically on failure). Typical time: 180 s.

faces.description: texel-3d-pro only: target face count. Omit for automatic (maximum detail).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same generation, never charged twice. Default: derived from the parameters for 10 minutes; pass a new value to intentionally run the same prompt again.

image_url.description: Optional https URL of a reference image (one object, plain background works best).

max_credits.description: Highest price the user accepted (from quote_generation). The call fails with confirmation_required if missing.

model.description: texel-3d-pro (default, best), texel-3d-alt, texel-3d-express (fast), texel-3d-draft (cheapest, color only).

object.description: texel-3d-draft only: name of the object to extract (e.g. "chair"). Omit on a plain background.

prompt.description: Object to create, e.g. "a medieval wooden treasure chest". Required when no image_url is given.

save_to_library.description: Optional. When the generation succeeds, publish it in the public 3DTexel community library and add it to the user's library (free). Only if the user asked for it.

name: generate_3d_model
title: AI 3D Model Generator
